reasoning.title: Reasoning

Billing.description: What the call cost, as recorded against the caller's key.

model.description: Model id that served the call, after fallback.
model.title: Model

price_key.description: Admin keys only: the pricing-grid entry that priced the call.
price_key.title: Price Key

ChatCompletionChunk.description:
One `data:` event of a streamed completion (SSE).

The stream ends with `data: [DONE]`. A chunk carrying `usage` (and
`cost_usd` when the gateway computed it) always comes before `[DONE]`.
ChatCompletionChunk.title: ChatCompletionChunk

ChatCompletionRequest.description: OpenAI ``POST /v1/chat/completions`` body, plus two Plugboard fields.

model.description: `provider:model` (see GET /v1/models), or a bare model id, which is routed to the first active provider that serves it.
model.title: Model

temperature.description: Removed before forwarding for models that reject sampling parameters (Claude Opus 4.7 and later, Sonnet 5+, Haiku 5+).
temperature.title: Temperature

max_tokens.description: Renamed to max_completion_tokens for OpenAI o-series models.
max_tokens.title: Max Tokens

tools.description: OpenAI tool definitions. A CLI subscription route (subprocess provider) does not serve them: a non-empty list gets 400 unsupported_on_cli, unless another provider of the same model serves the request.
tools.title: Tools

tool_choice.description: OpenAI tool choice. A CLI subscription route (subprocess provider) does not serve a value other than none or auto: 400 unsupported_on_cli, unless another provider of the same model serves the request.
tool_choice.title: Tool Choice

response_format.description: OpenAI structured output (json_object, json_schema). A CLI subscription route (subprocess provider) serves type text only: any other gets 400 unsupported_on_cli, unless another provider of the same model serves the request.
response_format.title: Response Format

cache.description: Plugboard: false bypasses the response cache for this call.
cache.title: Cache

session_id.description: Plugboard: the gateway keeps the conversation and prepends it, so only the new turn is sent. Same as the X-LLM-Session-ID header.
session_id.title: Session Id

ChatCompletionRequest.title: ChatCompletionRequest

content.description: Text, or OpenAI content parts (text, image_url, input_audio...). A CLI subscription route (subprocess provider) serves text parts only: any other part gets 400 unsupported_on_cli, unless another provider of the same model serves the request.
content.title: Content

ClientInfo.description:
Who the key belongs to, its limits and this month's spend.

Every field but `client_id` is absent for an unauthenticated call.

remaining_usd.description: null when the key has no monthly limit.
remaining_usd.title: Remaining Usd

ClientInfo.title: ClientInfo

key_display.description: Prefix of the key followed by ***.
key_display.title: Key Display

DecisionBilled.description:
Cost recorded against the key. `billed`: Jev from the reported input
tokens, or Laya (free, 0); `estimated`: Jev usage missing or invalid, billed
at the 64,000-token default context.
DecisionBilled.title: DecisionBilled

limits.description: Effective engine limits: timeout_seconds is the local worker budget (30 seconds, including startup/hash/load); api_timeout_seconds is the separate 45-second API envelope. Laya head_tokens and question_branch_tokens share a total head budget of 192 (English) or 256 (multilingual) from pinned configs. instruction_tokens is null: instructions share that head with options and separators, and their remaining budget is checked per request.
limits.title: Limits

DecisionPricing.description: Price per million tokens; Jev: official input price, output free; Laya: 0.
DecisionPricing.title: DecisionPricing

DecisionResponse.description: Answers retain engine-specific confidence; a cost is null only when unrecorded.
DecisionResponse.title: DecisionResponse

DecisionUnrecorded.description: The engine answered but the usage ledger could not record the call.
DecisionUnrecorded.title: DecisionUnrecorded

embedding.description: Floats, or base64 little-endian float32 with encoding_format=base64.
embedding.title: Embedding

available.description: The route resolves (registered, active, loopback engine); no probe.
available.title: Available

dimensions.description: Known once a call was served since the restart.
dimensions.title: Dimensions

EmbeddingServed.description:
What served the call: the registered local engine and the model digest
it reported (Ollama /api/tags), so a caller can pin the model of an index.
EmbeddingServed.title: EmbeddingServed

ErrorResponse.description:
FastAPI's error body. Upstream timeouts (503) add `retry_after` and a
Retry-After header, as does an exhausted provider quota (429) when the
provider gave a delay; a failing CLI provider (502) adds its exit details
for the admin only. A chat model no provider knows (404) adds `code` and
`hint`. A chat whose candidate providers all stayed at their concurrency
cap (503) adds `code` providers_busy, `retry_after` and Retry-After; one
the global chat cap kept waiting for a slot (503) adds `code`
server_busy, `retry_after` and Retry-After. A
chat model of a provider the admin turned off (503) adds `code`
provider_disabled and `hint`, without Retry-After. A chat request only
CLI subscription routes could serve, asking for what they cannot serve
(400), adds `code` unsupported_on_cli, `unsupported` (the refused fields)
and `hint`. A prompt a CLI subscription route finds too long (400) adds
`code` context_length_exceeded, `error_ref`, `provider_name` and
`model_id`. A model a CLI subscription route's account plan does not serve
(400) adds `code` model_not_supported_by_subscription, `hint`,
`error_ref`, `provider_name` and `model_id`.

code.description: Stable reason for programs, when the route gives one: unsupported_on_cli (chat, 400), context_length_exceeded (chat, 400), model_not_supported_by_subscription (chat, 400), model_not_found (chat, 404), providers_busy (chat, 503), server_busy (chat and preflight, 503; also a preflight item's error), provider_disabled (chat, 503).
code.title: Code

unsupported.description: With code unsupported_on_cli: the request fields a CLI subscription route cannot serve (tools, tool_choice, functions, function_call, response_format, content:<part type>).
unsupported.title: Unsupported

hint.description: What to do next, when the gateway knows.
hint.title: Hint

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse

Health.description:
Liveness: always 200 while the process answers. The provider list is
on the admin `GET /providers`, the auth posture on `GET /health/ready`.
Health.title: Health

InflightCall.description: One chat call: running, or finished (then `outcome` is set).

phase.description: waiting_slot, running, waiting_provider, cli_queue, cli_running, cli_parse, or done once finished.
phase.title: Phase

status.description: HTTP status of the answer; null while it runs.
status.title: Status

phase_elapsed_s.description: Time in the current phase; running calls only.
phase_elapsed_s.title: Phase Elapsed S

slow.description: True after 60 s. A slow call is still running, not broken.
slow.title: Slow

InflightCall.title: InflightCall

InflightResponse.title: InflightResponse

account_compatible.title: Account Compatible

connected.title: Connected

account_compatible.description: Whether the calling key may use this model.

items.description: At most 10 pairs; each ping counts as one chat call (rpm, budget).
items.title: Items

error.description: Why the pair failed (closed code, never the provider's text): the model does not resolve, is not allowed for the key, no provider knows it (the chat routes' 404 model_not_found; not pinged), the monthly budget is spent, the key has a budget and the model no known price, the key's rpm limit is reached, the provider failed, the provider stayed at its concurrency cap (nothing was called), or the model belongs to a provider the admin turned off (the chat routes' 503 provider_disabled; nothing was called), or the global cap of concurrent chat requests stayed full when the pair's turn came (the chat routes' 503 server_busy; not pinged, or its provider's slot given back).
error.title: Error

Ready.description:
Readiness: `ready` is false when `usage_db` is not `ok`, `cli` is
`fail` or `auth` is `fail`; `ollama` and `background` never block.

checks.description: usage_db: ok|fail; cli: ok|fail|none; auth: ok|dev|fail; ollama: ok|unreachable|unknown|not_configured; background: ok|degraded.
checks.title: Checks

429.description: Rate limit or monthly spending limit exceeded.

schema.description: When stream is true: `data: <ChatCompletionChunk>` events, then `data: [DONE]`. The usage chunk comes before [DONE].

X-Cost-USD.description: Cost of the call, when billed (non-streamed answers).

X-Request-ID.description: Correlation id, also written to the gateway logs.

429.description: Rate limit or monthly spending limit exceeded, or the quota of the last provider tried is exhausted (retry_after and Retry-After when it gives a delay).

400.description: Invalid request; nothing was billed. code unsupported_on_cli: only CLI subscription routes (subprocess providers) serve the model and the request asks for what they cannot serve: tools, a tool_choice other than none or auto, functions, a function_call other than none or auto, a response_format other than text, or a content part other than text; unsupported lists them, hint says what to send; nothing was called. code context_length_exceeded: a CLI subscription route found the prompt too long for the model's context; no other provider was tried. code model_not_supported_by_subscription: the account plan a CLI subscription route is signed in with does not serve the model (codex with a ChatGPT account); hint says what to do, no other provider was tried. Without code: a body that is not valid JSON or not a JSON object, a model that is not a string or is removed, missing or invalid messages, a session_id that is a list or an object, a decision model (use /v1/decisions), or a request an HTTP provider rejected (context too long, parameters; error_ref): after the other candidates were tried, or at once when it was to serve stream true live (a live stream goes to one provider only).

402.description: The key has a monthly budget and the model no known price; nothing was called.

403.description: The key may not use this model.

404.description: No provider knows the model: no provider ID prefixes it, no provider lists it, and every active provider has a model list. code is model_not_found, hint says what to send; nothing was called.

413.description: Request body larger than MAX_BODY_BYTES (10 MB by default).

502.description: The provider failed or answered with an error.

503.description: Provider timeout (retry_after), the global cap of concurrent chat requests full for the whole wait (code server_busy, Retry-After 5), every candidate provider at its concurrency cap (code providers_busy, Retry-After 5), or the model belongs to a provider the admin turned off (code provider_disabled, hint, no Retry-After); nothing was called.

429.description: Key already has a decision in flight, queue full or wait over, a key limit exceeded, or TypeSafe's quota or rate limit exhausted (Retry-After when TypeSafe gives it).

403.description: The client key may not use this decision engine.

413.description: Decision request exceeds the byte limit.

422.description: Invalid typed question or unsupported engine capability.

502.description: Invalid response from the decision engine.
